comment: Every command the deck can fire, and the ONE place each one is written: a slide renders the
string from here and `POST /step/:id` sends that same string into the tmux pane, so what the
room reads and what the shell runs cannot drift.
`interrupt: true` sends C-c before the command — for a step that follows something still
streaming. Without it the server refuses to fire into a busy pane rather than interleave keys
with whatever you are typing yourself.
`jr2 run` attaches by default and a run parked at a Gate parks INDEFINITELY, which would hold
the pane for the rest of the talk — hence `--detach` on `task`, and the runId captured into
$RUN for the Gate deliveries that follow (the pane is one long-lived shell, so it remembers).

up.note: Converges the instance. Warm, every image reports `fresh — build skipped`.

ping.note: No Agent, no Sandbox, no model — the Machine and nothing else.

task.cmd: RUN=$(jr2 run task --input '{"prompt":"Add a --version flag to the CLI."}' --detach | jq -r .runId) && echo "run $RUN"
task.note: Detached on purpose: the run parks at the review Gate and would hold this pane.

watch.note: Optional — the Console behind these slides is already showing this.

gate.note: The Gate names the pending decision and the events it accepts.

changes.note: A workflow-defined event. The Machine goes back for another Turn; the Workspace lives.

approve.note: Tears the Workspace down. The Machine never pushes.

down.note: Only if you want to show it — the instance is gone after this.
